actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: Donald Trump is dominating headlines following his keynote appearance at the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, where he proposed a controversial $5,000 cash dividend for American adults if Republicans retain control of Congress. His administration also faces active legal battles over executive orders, federal appointments, and mail-in voting restrictions alongside foreign policy decisions regarding Iran and Saudi Arabia.

actors.name: JD Vance
actors.role: Vice President of the United States
actors.blurb: JD Vance delivered primetime keynote speeches at the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, establishing himself as Donald Trump's prospective political heir for 2028. Vance focused on traditional family values, aggressively attacked Democrats, and rallied the party base ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
